bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 21
test "$(systemctl --user is-enabled gace-userbot-verify.service)" = enabled || exit 22
test -f scripts/userbot_test_client.py || exit 23
test -f scripts/userbot_resident_ipc.py || exit 24
python3 -B scripts/userbot_test_client.py health || exit 25
python3 -B - <<'PY'
import ast
from pathlib import Path
s=ast.parse(Path('scripts/userbot_resident_ipc.py').read_text())
actions=[]
for node in ast.walk(s):
 if isinstance(node,ast.Assign):
  for name in node.targets:
   if isinstance(name,ast.Name) and name.id=='ACTIONS':
    value=node.value
    if isinstance(value,ast.Call) and value.args:
     if isinstance(value.args[0],(ast.Set,ast.List,ast.Tuple)):
      actions=[x.value for x in value.args[0].elts if isinstance(x,ast.Constant) and isinstance(x.value,str)]
assert 'health' in actions, 'NO_HEALTH_ACTION'
print('LIVE_USERBOT_ALLOWED_ACTIONS='+','.join(sorted(actions)))
print('LIVE_USERBOT_HAS_CREATEVDOBOT_DM_ACTION='+str(any('vdo' in a or 'creator' in a or 'sticker' in a for a in actions)))
PY
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 26
echo RESIDENT_USERBOT_HEALTH_AND_ACTIONS=PASS
